in_hebrew.name: Darb
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift from God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Darb הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek, Darb means 'gift from God'. This name is deeply rooted in the Christian faith and is a reminder of the blessings bestowed upon us by the divine.

in_greek.name: Darb
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Gift from God
in_greek.long_meaning: Darb είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Greek, Darb means 'gift from God'. This name is deeply rooted in the Christian faith and is a reminder of the blessings bestowed upon us by the divine.

in_latin.name: Darb
in_latin.meaning: nomen quod a lingua Hebraica originem ducit, significat: civitas, regio, planities, apertus, liber
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Darb videtur habere formam , significans 'homo a civitate originem ducens', 'regio', 'planities', 'apertus', 'liber'. Sic, nomen Darb consideratur nomen commune in lingua Latina, radicem habens civitates. Darb potest significare etiam 'locus', 'regio', 'planities', 'apertus', 'liber'. Darb est nomen commune et gravitas in lingua Latina. Darb est nomen in omnibus ecclesiis orientalibus. Darb est nomen frequenti in civitatibus orbis terrarum. Darb est pars nominis civitatis 'Darb el-Abtar' ( 'Darb el-Abtar' 'Darb el-Abtar').
